title: Grill asks a follow-up when an answer is vague
body:
### Summary

When a human gives a vague answer during `aayu grill`, the interview asks one follow-up question before moving on.

### Problem

Grilled stories often carry criteria such as "works well" that the Ready check accepts but nobody can observe; four of the last ten stories were sent back at review for that.

### Scope

In scope: follow-up questions in the grill skill and the CLI interview, and eval cases for them. Out of scope: other verbs' interviews.

### Expected paths

internal/cli/grill*.go
skills/grill/**
evals/cases/grill/**
